why: Small research task judged on citations + factual accuracy against known-stable facts (Python 1991, Ruby 1995).
task: Using en.wikipedia.org only, find the year each of these programming languages first appeared: Python, and Ruby. Write comparison.md containing: each language with its first-appearance year and the exact Wikipedia article URL you took it from, then a one-line comparison of which came first and by how many years.

checks.ground: Python first appeared in February 1991 (Wikipedia: 'Python (programming language)'). Ruby first appeared in 1995 (Wikipedia: 'Ruby (programming language)'). So Python predates Ruby by 4 years.
checks.rubric: Score 0-10. To score >= 7 the report must: (a) state 1991 for Python and 1995 for Ruby (any other year for either = automatic fail, score <= 3); (b) cite a plausible, correctly-formed Wikipedia article URL for EACH language (a made-up or clearly wrong URL = fabrication = automatic fail); (c) correctly conclude Python came first, by 4 years. Deduct points for missing either citation or a wrong gap calculation.
